doc.description: Connects a hardware modem (usually USB/serial) or a UDP link with the Ivy bus: telemetry from the aircraft to the ground tools, and the uplink messages back.

option.description: Enable trafic statistics on standard output
Disables the uplink (from the ground to the aircraft).
Add local timestamp to messages sent over ivy
Available protocols are modem,pprz,pprz2 and xbee. Default is pprz
Broadcast on <udp_broadcast_addr>, e.g. for multiple simulated aircrafts
Sets whether the link is a redundant link. Set this flag and the id flag to use multiple links
Sets the link id. If multiple links are used, each must have a unique id. Default is -1
Sets the period (in ms) of the LINK_REPORT status message. Default is 1000
Sets the period (in ms) of the PING message sent to aircrafs. Default is 5000
Sets the time (in ms) after which an aircraft is regarded as dead/off if no messages are received. Default is 5000ms, set to zero to disable.
